slides.headline: does the *full moon* make people act crazy?
slides.dek: the next one is dec 23. here is what the records say

slides.headline: “everyone acts unhinged on a full moon”
slides.body: large reviews of hospital, emergency and police records have mostly found no reliable link between the full moon and wild behaviour. some small studies suggest people sleep a little less around it. tired is not unhinged.

slides.headline: a full moon is just the *moon* opposite the sun
slides.body: earth sits between them, so we see the whole lit side. it happens about every 29.5 days. the moon is not closer or stronger on a full moon. it is just brighter, and brighter nights are memorable.

slides.headline: astrologers read full moons as *culminations*
slides.body: a peak, not a breakdown: things you started around the new moon come to a head. the dec 23 full moon is in cancer, which reads as home, family and who you miss.

slides.headline: nobody is *crazy*. some people are just finally honest
slides.body: say the honest thing. blame the moon if you need to.
